description: This BLACK+DECKER 4,100 BTU DOE (8000 BTU ASHRAE 128) portable air conditioner is your best friend during the summer months, supplying cool, free-flowing, and comfortable air 24/7 up to 350 square feet. When it comes to ac units for rooms, our portable cooler (15.3” x 14” x 24.8) has 3 functionalities all in one: fan, dehumidifier, and cool. Included with your new portable ac air conditioner and 8000 btu air conditioner window unit (45.8 lbs.) is a fully functional remote control so you can set your temperature in rooms up to 22 feet away— although will not function between walls and other obstacles. With a 24-hour timer that can be set on or off, slide-out washable filter, and auto water evaporation, the benefits of this room air conditioner speak for themselves. Enjoy the sleep mode function, where the decided air conditioning temperature will increase by 1°F/1°C the first 60 minutes— then another 1°F/1°C for the following 60 minutes—and eventually remain at the selected temperature for 6 hours before shutting off automatically. When it comes to portable air conditioners, this one can't be beat. Included is a top mounted control panel with LED display and an easy-to-install window kit so you can place your indoor air conditioner and room cooler air conditioner anywhere. With four casters on the bottom and two side handles, easily slide your air conditioner no window into any room of the house. Our portable ac unit and portable air conditioner 8000 btu comes with a power cord and plug storage for optimal convenience and uses R32 refrigerant for no Ozone depletion. Truly, one of the best room air conditioners! The large front vented airflow outlet with 2-way adjustable louvers ensures superior functionality and total room cooler satisfaction. Stay cool during the hot months with BLACK+DECKER!
